thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty - P1: Missing tenant traces for PraxisFinance (VPC). Auto-cc: @maria (oncall), @alex, @jane
maria (oncall): I'm on it. Paging eng-runtime and eng-ml. Initial alert says traces not flowing for PraxisFinance dedicated VPC. Customers reporting inability to correlate errors across services.
alex (eng-runtime): Looking. Do we have any recent bridge config changes? Last deploy was 03:12 UTC by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: service/obs-forwarder v2.9.4 at 03:12:15 UTC
sam (eng-ml): FYI, PraxisFinance runs on dedicated pool dp-12, using per-tenant forwarder with cross-account role.
jane (customer-success): Customer is seeing missing spans since ~02:58 UTC. They're requesting an intermediate solution; they need traces for their incident postmortem.
rob (solutions): Can we grant them a temporary log access link or replay traces from retention? What's the last time we saw traces in their tracing project?
alex (eng-runtime): Querying. `kubectl logs -n obs-forwarder obs-forwarder-57f | grep praxisfinance` -> nothing for spans since 02:55.
alex (eng-runtime): It looks like the trace-forwarder upstream TLS connection to praxis-vpc-forwarder timed out and backoffed. Stack shows 502 -> connection refused.
maria (oncall): Any recent IAM/key rotation? Security team? @security-bot
security-bot: No global KMS rotations in the last 24h. There was a scheduled credential pruning for stale roles at 02:50 UTC in account infra-svc.
sam (eng-ml): That might have removed the temporary role the forwarder used for cross-account PutSpan. Checking role-assume logs.
alex (eng-runtime): Confirmed: `assume-role` call for role arn:aws:iam::PF-ACCOUNT:role/rdw-trace-forwarder returned AccessDenied at 02:49:58.
rob (solutions): So forwarder lost permission and started failing. Can we reattach role or create a short-term role for mitigation?
alex (eng-runtime): Proposing mitigation: 1) Recreate a temporary role with same policy, 2) update forwarder's env var with new role ARN, 3) restart forwarder pod. Risks: short disruption for a few seconds.
maria (oncall): Go for it. Coordinate with customer-success so PraxisFinance knows we'll have a short window.
jane (customer-success): I'll message the customer and ask them to expect ~2 minute window. Also ask if they want temporary log copy while we restore.
alex (eng-runtime): Creating role policy now. `aws iam create-role --role-name rdw-temp-trace-forwarder-praxis --assume-role-policy-document file://assume.json`
alex (eng-runtime): Role created. Updating forwarder ConfigMap with NEW_ROLE_ARN and rolling restart: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/obs-forwarder -n obs`.
deploy-bot: Rollout started: deployment/obs-forwarder by alex at 04:08:22 UTC
maria (oncall): Restart in progress. Watching pods.
alex (eng-runtime): Pod obs-forwarder-57f terminating, new pod obs-forwarder-9bd started. Logs show assume-role success and spans resuming at 04:09:14.
sam (eng-ml): I can confirm traces for PraxisFinance reappearing in the tracing store. Query: `service:checkout` spans from PraxisFinance now show up for 04:09+.
jane (customer-success): Customer confirms they see traces reappearing and can correlate requests. They're asking for a postmortem and whether this will happen again.
maria (oncall): We'll document: root cause - credential pruning removed long-lived role used by per-tenant forwarder for PraxisFinance; mitigation - created temporary role and rolled forwarder; long-term - add role to allowlist or use rotation-aware role assumption with instance-profile.
rob (solutions): Also suggest adding alerting on assume-role failures to surface this earlier and an automated remediation to reattach roles.
alex (eng-runtime): Filing follow-up ticket: INF-7420 - "per-tenant forwarder role hardening + assume-role failure alert" with steps: allowlist, automation, and tests. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-infra.
sam (eng-ml): Also enabling a short-term log-forwarder for PraxisFinance to S3 bucket we control so CS can fetch missed spans if needed. I'll kick that off.
jane (customer-success): Thanks team. I'll send customer-facing summary and ETA for PR to infra in 48hrs.
maria (oncall): Closing P1 after verification. Marking handoff to eng-runtime for remediation work.
incident-bot: Incident P1 closed by maria (oncall) at 04:20:34 UTC (duration 00:12:45).
